record.question: How is W related to P?
record.explanation: Under the shared family-tree interpretation, H and P are siblings and W is H's husband. The husband of P's sister is P's brother-in-law. The original shared statement must be read with this question. Verified solution (unofficial); original printed paper and worked derivation checked on 26 October 2026.
